Callout.Name: Photographing a Police Station
Callout.Message: Person photographing a police station, reported by staff.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot with a camera, no offence reported.

Script.Line: I am filming a building. That is not a crime.
It is a public pavement and I am allowed to stand on a public pavement.
You can look at the camera. There is a building on it. Nothing else.

Lines.Approach: Nothing has happened, he is just taking pictures of the building. Staff want him spoken to.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
